headline: Ukraine defence minister says Starlink restored
dek: Overnight Oct 23-24, Crimea lost power peninsula-wide: Sevastopol, Simferopol, Yalta, Feodosia, Dzhankoi, Alushta, Yevpatoria reported without electricity; Aksyonov said restrictions on electricity and water were imposed after a drone attack on main power grids outside the region; Razvozhayev…
sources: Sergei Aksyonov (Moscow-installed head of Crimea, Telegram); Mikhail Razvozhayev (Sevastopol governor); Russian Defence Ministry; Ukraine General Staff; Ukrainian defence minister Evhenii Khmara; OSINT channel Exilenova+
fault_line: Knocking out an occupied peninsula's grid: legitimate degradation of Russia's war machine, or collective punishment of 2.5 million civilians ahead of winter?

sections.what_happened: Overnight Oct 23-24, Crimea lost power peninsula-wide: Sevastopol, Simferopol, Yalta, Feodosia, Dzhankoi, Alushta, Yevpatoria reported without electricity; Aksyonov said restrictions on electricity and water were imposed after a drone attack on main power grids outside the region; Razvozhayev confirmed Sevastopol lost power from damage to infrastructure outside the city. Exilenova+ links the blackout to the 500/220 kV Taman substation in Krasnodar Krai (through which all four Kerch power-bridge lines pass); NASA FIRMS detected a thermal anomaly there, suggesting fire; NetBlocks recorded Crimea internet traffic falling to near-zero. Russia's Defence Ministry says it downed 616 Ukrainian drones overnight across 20+ regions. Togliatti mayor Ilya Sukhikh confirmed drone damage to industrial infrastructure; Ukraine's General Staff says it struck a Togliatti petrochemical plant (explosion and fire). Ukraine separately confirmed the Friday strike on Proton-Electrotex in Oryol (3 killed, per Reuters). Khmara said Saturday that Starlink in Ukraine is restored with speeds over 400 km/h and stable -- an update that supersedes the 'still not restored' position recorded in totw-20261024-1300-04. CAUTION: the Taman substation as the cause is OSINT + FIRMS anomaly, NOT independently confirmed; the 616-drone figure is a Russian MOD claim; the Togliatti plant identity is a Ukrainian claim with only mayoral damage confirmation.
sections.what_verified: Blackout: Russian-installed officials (primary for their own admissions) + Ukrinform + OSINT/FIRMS. 616 drones: Russian MOD only.
sections.what_disputed: Russian MOD's 616-drone claim is uncorroborated and self-serving (air-defence claims routinely inflated by both sides); Taman-cause link rests on OSINT + one thermal anomaly, and United24/Militarnyi themselves note damage extent unconfirmed. Prior scan's Zelensky position (Starlink still not restored) is now contradicted by Khmara's Saturday restoration claim -- restoration itself is a Ukrainian-ministry claim, not independently measured.
sections.why_matters: The energy war just went both ways in one night: while Russia sent 126 drones at Ukraine, Ukraine darkened Crimea. Lead with the Aksyonov admission (Russia's own appointee confirming the blackout), then the Taman single-point-of-failure -- four power lines, one substation. Treat the 616 figure as a Russian claim, not a count.
sections.context: Background: NEW (overnight Oct 23-24; reverse energy war) -- Crimea-wide blackout after drone strikes on power infrastructure; Russia says 616 Ukrainian drones downed; Togliatti petrochemical plant hit; Ukraine defence minister says Starlink restored

totw_analysis: Our read: The energy war just went both ways in one night: while Russia sent 126 drones at Ukraine, Ukraine darkened Crimea. Lead with the Aksyonov admission (Russia's own appointee confirming the blackout), then the Taman single-point-of-failure -- four power lines, one substation. Treat the 616 figure as a Russian claim, not a count. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Knocking out an occupied peninsula's grid: legitimate degradation of Russia's war machine, or collective punishment of 2.5 million civilians ahead of winter?
